studio-portrait.prompt: studio portrait of a young woman with expressive eyes and natural makeup, seated against a seamless mid-grey backdrop, calm confident gaze straight into the lens, visible skin texture and fine facial detail

street-portrait.prompt: environmental street portrait of a man in a worn leather jacket leaning against a weathered brick wall, candid natural expression, late afternoon light raking across his face, shallow depth separating him from a busy street

wedding.prompt: wedding photograph of a bride and groom in a sunlit garden, the bride laughing mid-turn in her white lace dress, backlit rim light through the veil, dreamy romantic atmosphere

child.prompt: candid photograph of a small child running through tall grass laughing, arms outstretched, sunlit dust motes in the air, unposed joyful energy

dancer.prompt: photograph of a contemporary dancer mid-leap on a dark stage, body arched in a sculptural pose, dramatic single spotlight from above, dust and chalk powder suspended in the light beam

elder.prompt: intimate portrait of an elderly craftsman with deeply lined hands and weathered face, looking down at his work, soft window light from the side, every wrinkle and pore rendered with dignity

mountain-sunrise.prompt: wide landscape of jagged snow-capped mountain peaks at sunrise, valley filled with a sea of low clouds, first pink-orange light striking the summits, sky in soft gradient from amber to deep blue

seaside.prompt: rocky coastline with black volcanic boulders at sunset, waves washing over dark wet rocks, dramatic orange and purple sky, sea spray suspended in the air

waterfall.prompt: a tall waterfall cascading over moss-covered basalt cliffs deep in a green gorge, water crashing into a turquoise pool below, fine mist filling the air, ferns clinging to the rock walls

misty-forest.prompt: a forest path disappearing into thick morning fog between immense mossy tree trunks, shafts of pale light cutting through the mist, dew on spiderwebs, deep quiet atmosphere

desert.prompt: abstract sand dunes in late afternoon, one sharp sinuous ridge curving across the frame, wind-blown sand streaming off the crest, razor-sharp light-shadow boundary, minimalist composition

snowfield.prompt: a lone figure walking across an endless snowfield under a brilliant blue sky, footprint trail leading into the distance, blinding white expanse with deep blue shadows in the drifts

neon-night.prompt: rain-soaked city street at night, walls of glowing neon signs in Japanese and Chinese reflecting in the wet asphalt, pedestrians with umbrellas silhouetted against the light, steam rising from a vent

starscape.prompt: the Milky Way arching across a pitch-black desert night sky, thousands of stars, silhouetted rock formations in the foreground, faint airglow on the horizon

light-trails.prompt: a city overpass at night from above, headlights and taillights streaming into long continuous ribbons of red and white light, static city skyline sharp behind the light trails

fairground.prompt: a ferris wheel and carousel spinning at night, their lights blurred into concentric circles of colour, a child watching in silhouette, candy-coloured glow on the fairground floor

concert.prompt: a rock band performing on stage, singer leaning into the microphone drenched in sweat, hard backlit spotlights cutting through haze, silhouetted audience with raised hands in the foreground

architecture.prompt: a brutalist concrete building photographed against a clear sky, strong repeating geometric grid of windows, converging vertical lines, harsh midday shadow dividing the facade into light and dark planes

interior.prompt: the interior of a minimalist modern house, floor-to-ceiling windows pouring daylight across a polished concrete floor, a single chair and a long shadow, calm architectural composition

old-town.prompt: a narrow ancient Chinese water-town alley at dusk, wet flagstones reflecting warm lantern light, whitewashed walls and dark tiled eaves, a lone cyclist turning a corner

street-doc.prompt: a decisive-moment street photograph, a man stepping over a puddle mid-stride, his reflection perfect in the still water, layered pedestrians and signage behind him, complex urban choreography

market.prompt: a bustling morning market in an old Asian city, a vendor weighing vegetables on a brass scale under a bare bulb, steam and smoke, hands and produce filling the frame with life

train.prompt: a freight train thundering through a rural valley, exhaust and dust swirling, long lens compressing the carriages into a solid wall of steel, distant hills layered behind

sport-cycle.prompt: a road cyclist sprinting out of the saddle, muscle definition and tendons straining, water bottle rattling, sweat spray, motion implied by the body position

sport-field.prompt: a long jumper at the exact instant of takeoff, sand exploding behind her heel, body fully extended, stadium crowd blurred into colour behind

wildlife.prompt: a red fox pausing mid-step in a frost-covered meadow, ears pricked, breath steaming in the cold air, fur detail sharp, background melting into golden bokeh

bird-flight.prompt: a kingfisher diving toward the water, wings swept back in a streamline, droplet trail behind it, water surface moments before impact

flower-macro.prompt: macro photograph of a dew-covered spiderweb strung between lavender stems, each droplet a tiny refracting lens, background dissolved into pure soft colour

insect-macro.prompt: an extreme close-up of a jumping spider on a leaf edge, every hair and each of its eight eyes in razor detail, iridescent chelicerae catching the light

still-life.prompt: still life of a half-peeled orange, a chipped ceramic bowl and a tarnished silver spoon on dark linen, single soft window light from the left, deep shadow falling to the right

food.prompt: overhead food photograph of a steaming bowl of hand-pulled noodles, scattered spring onions and chili oil swirls, chopsticks lifting one strand, moody dark wood table

cafe-window.prompt: a barista pouring latte art into a cup on a worn wooden counter, steam curling into a shaft of morning light from the window, dust motes and warm backlit haze

car-night.prompt: a classic sports car parked under a sodium streetlamp on a wet road at night, paintwork reflecting the lights, faint mist, cinematic stillness
